skill.summary: Book flights to Vietnam including Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Da Nang. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified the workflow to strictly require CLI (flyai) outputs for all travel queries.
- Enhanced parameter collection rules and made asking follow-ups more precise.
- Expanded and clarified playbooks for various flight search scenarios (cheapest, fastest, direct).
- Added new validation and formatting rules for output, including mandatory booking links and brand tags.
- Improved domain knowledge and parameter mapping table for better accuracy.
- Updated compatibility section and enriched usage examples.
